blocks.text: The Victoria’s Secret (VS) Fashion Show made its sizzling comeback on October 18 at the Sony Pictures Studios, in Culver City, California. The single idea of beauty is now much bigger, the runway has become a platform where icons and angels from all shapes, sizes, and backgrounds come together, showing that glamour doesn’t have to exclude anyone. Bella Hadid opened the show with her floral runway look while sporting the iconic VS wing. But this year, audiences were surprise to see Kylie Jenner walking her first-ever VS runway, wearing the historic $50 million Fantasy Bra, studded with 4,410 natural diamonds and […]...
